verdict.rationale: A tax-agency portal could plausibly offer a chatbot or natural-language interface, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only conventional web forms, an authenticated portal shell, and human live support during business hours. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI all returned 404, and no natural-language command capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
